signal: AiDASH raised a $50M Series C led by Lightrock and is scaling its satellite-first vegetation management products across the US, UK, Europe and ANZ

email.subject1: pipeline AiDASH is leaving on the table
email.body1:
Zach, saw AiDASH close its $50M Series C and scale across the US, UK, Europe and ANZ.

A raise plus multi-region growth usually creates more in-market accounts than reps can touch before they ramp, and coverage gaps are where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for AiDASH off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zach, quick follow-up for AiDASH.

Post-raise, with new regions opening, the number climbs faster than the team can. Most teams can't say how many meetings they need to book to hit target across markets, so coverage gaps surface late and the quarter slips.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings AiDASH needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Zach, last bit of proof for AiDASH.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AiDASH's reply rate likely compares to other scaling startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zach, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline across new regions without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The post-raise expansion stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-region motion? I'll tailor it to AiDASH either way.
